                    "inverse-on-surface": "#eff0f7",

                    "on-secondary": "#ffffff",

                    "on-surface": "#191c21",
                    "inverse-surface": "#2e3036",
                    "error-container": "#ffdad6",
                    "surface-container-highest": "#e1e2e9",
                    "inverse-primary": "#a5c8ff",
                    "primary-fixed-dim": "#a5c8ff",
                    "error": "#ba1a1a",
                    "on-primary-fixed": "#001c3a",
                    "on-tertiary-container": "#ffcaad",
                    "secondary-container": "#fed000",
                    "on-surface-variant": "#414751",
                    "on-primary": "#ffffff",
                    "tertiary-fixed": "#ffdbc9",
                    "tertiary-fixed-dim": "#ffb68d",
                    "surface-dim": "#d8dae1",
                    "outline-variant": "#c1c6d3",
                    "on-tertiary": "#ffffff",
                    "on-error": "#ffffff",
                    "background": "#f9f9ff",
                    "on-secondary-fixed": "#231b00",

<style>
      body {
        font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        background-color: #f9f9ff;
      }
      .material-symbols-outlined {
        font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 0, 'wght' 400, 'GRAD' 0, 'opsz' 24;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .login-card {
        box-shadow: 0px 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
      }
      .input-field:focus-within {
        border-color: #005daa;
        border-width: 2px;
      }
      .status-strip {
        width: 4px;
        height: 100%;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        background-color: #004581;
        border-top-left-radius: 16px;
        border-bottom-left-radius: 16px;
      }

<style>
    body {
      min-height: max(884px, 100dvh);

  </head>
<body class="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-surface overflow-x-hidden">
<!-- Hero/Background Decoration Section -->
<div class="fixed top-0 left-0 w-full h-[309px] overflow-hidden z-0">
<div class="absolute inset-0 bg-primary opacity-90"></div>
<div class="absolute inset-0" data-alt="A cinematic, high-angle wide shot of a massive electrical substation and cooling towers during the golden hour. The sunlight casts long, dramatic shadows across industrial machinery, reinforcing the themes of power and reliability. The aesthetic is clean and professional with deep blues and metallic grays, reflecting a high-end corporate environment for PLN Nusa Daya." style="background-image: url('https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDwbTYlLYZdoLRiPznd5Nf0LZOArAw03OD8AGqc2jP1oJYNUwK2KBJARmmFgqO6EMjzPm4v7eLZu9GhOTBwzayu7Hei3774gvcI0oVskgfxg6IvZZeLGHgtXr_wOO-RV7ImpKLXhA4EDmhPugar1_zoeVcjfK7_tMPlTX3Dnw-X8ytuAywsDrOa2aYK0sr5JARAm36__7_MFXGE1O58Pf4IUnPFXpn2UmRTSEg_QPqQo2FstPE_SRz_')"></div>
<div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-primary/20 to-surface"></div>
</div>
<!-- Main Content Container -->
<main class="relative z-10 flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-margin-mobile pt-20 pb-10">
<!-- Brand Logo Area -->
<div class="mb-stack-lg text-center">
<div class="bg-surface-container-lowest p-stack-md rounded-full shadow-sm inline-block mb-stack-md">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[48px] text-primary" data-icon="engineering" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">engineering</span>
</div>
<h1 class="font-display-lg text-display-lg text-surface-container-lowest drop-shadow-md">PLN Nusa Daya</h1>
</div>
<!-- Login Card -->
<div class="w-full max-w-md bg-surface-container-lowest rounded-xl login-card relative overflow-hidden border border-outline-variant/30 px-gutter py-10 sm:px-10">
<!-- Left Side Identity Strip -->
<div class="status-strip"></div>
<div class="mb-stack-lg">
<h2 class="font-headline-md-mobile text-headline-md-mobile text-on-surface mb-stack-sm">Selamat Datang</h2>
<p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">Masuk untuk mengakses sistem HAR PLN Nusa Daya</p>
</div>
<!-- Login Form -->
<form action="#" class="space-y-stack-md" onsubmit="return false;">
<!-- Username Field -->
<div class="space-y-stack-sm">
<label class="font-label-lg text-label-lg text-on-surface-variant px-1" for="username">Username</label>
<div class="relative flex items-center group">
<span class="absolute left-4 material-symbols-outlined text-outline group-focus-within:text-primary" data-icon="person">person</span>
<input class="w-full h-touch-target-min pl-12 pr-4 bg-surface-container-low border border-outline-variant rounded-lg font-body-md text-body-md focus:outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-outline-variant" id="username" placeholder="Masukkan ID atau username" type="text"/>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Password Field -->
<div class="space-y-stack-sm">
<label class="font-label-lg text-label-lg text-on-surface-variant px-1" for="password">Kata Sandi</label>
<div class="relative flex items-center group">
<span class="absolute left-4 material-symbols-outlined text-outline group-focus-within:text-primary" data-icon="lock">lock</span>
<input class="w-full h-touch-target-min pl-12 pr-12 bg-surface-container-low border border-outline-variant rounded-lg font-body-md text-body-md focus:outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-outline-variant" id="password" placeholder="Masukkan kata sandi" type="password"/>
<button class="absolute right-3 p-2 text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high rounded-full transition-colors" id="togglePassword" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]" data-icon="visibility">visibility</span>
</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Remember Me & Forgot Password -->
<div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-stack-sm">
<label class="flex items-center cursor-pointer group">
<input class="w-5 h-5 rounded border-outline-variant text-primary focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-0 mr-3" type="checkbox"/>
<span class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant group-hover:text-on-surface transition-colors">Ingat saya</span>
</label>
<a class="font-label-lg text-label-lg text-primary hover:underline font-semibold" href="#">Lupa Sandi?</a>
</div>
<!-- Action Button -->
<button class="w-full h-touch-target-min mt-stack-lg bg-primary text-on-primary rounded-lg font-headline-sm text-headline-sm hover:bg-primary-container hover:shadow-lg active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-3" type="submit">
                    Masuk
                    <span class="material-symbols-outlined" data-icon="login">login</span>
</button>
</form>
<!-- Offline Mode Notice (Subtle) -->
<div class="mt-stack-lg pt-stack-lg border-t border-outline-variant flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-on-surface-variant text-[18px]" data-icon="bolt">bolt</span>
<span class="font-label-lg text-label-lg text-on-surface-variant">Sistem Pemeliharaan Mesin Terpadu</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Footer Identity -->
<footer class="mt-auto pt-stack-lg pb-stack-md text-center">
<p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant/80">
                © 2024 <span class="font-semibold text-on-surface-variant">PLN Nusa Daya</span>. <br/>
                Divisi HAR - Regional Jawa-Bali
            </p>
</footer>
</main>
<!-- Micro-interaction Scripts -->
<script>
        // Password Visibility Toggle
        const togglePassword = document.getElementById('togglePassword');
        const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
        
        togglePassword.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const type = passwordInput.getAttribute('type') === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
            passwordInput.setAttribute('type', type);
            
            const icon = this.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
            if (type === 'text') {
                icon.textContent = 'visibility_off';
                icon.setAttribute('data-icon', 'visibility_off');
            } else {
                icon.textContent = 'visibility';
                icon.setAttribute('data-icon', 'visibility');
            }
        });

        // Simple button ripple/active state handling
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('mousedown', function() {
                this.style.opacity = '0.9';
            });
            button.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
                this.style.opacity = '1';
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<body class="bg-background text-on-surface flex flex-col min-h-screen">
<!-- Top App Bar (Shared Component) -->
<header class="fixed top-0 left-0 w-full z-50 flex justify-between items-center h-touch-target-min px-margin-mobile bg-surface shadow-sm">
<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
<button class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary p-2 active:opacity-80 transition-opacity">arrow_back</button>
<h1 class="font-title-lg text-title-lg-mobile text-primary">Pilih Unit</h1>
</div>
<button class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary p-2 active:opacity-80 transition-opacity">notifications</button>
</header>
<!-- Main Content -->
<main class="flex-grow pt-[72px] pb-[100px] px-margin-mobile">
<!-- Header Text -->

<p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">Pilih lokasi kerja sebelum memulai HAR (Harkat & Pemeliharaan)</p>
</div>

<option value="k1">Kalimantan 1</option>
<option value="k2">Kalimantan 2</option>
</select>

</div>
</div>
<!-- Area Dropdown -->

<option disabled="" selected="" value="">Pilih Area</option>
<option value="sb">Site Bontang</option>
<option value="ss">Site Sangatta</option>
<option value="sk">Site Kutai</option>
</select>

</div>
</div>

<option disabled="" selected="" value="">Pilih Unit</option>
<option value="uba">ULD Batu Ampar</option>
<option value="umu">ULD Muara Wahau</option>

</div>

The aesthetic is clean, technical, and corporate, using a palette of blues, grays, and whites." style="background-image: url('https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuCy3oahjcAbfX9fcHHc44GLqRvzM4geZw1SS2amtUKbdTmpG-A-X4ZbSBo43c_qmtLz-UKwUPubdTHDpX2gnDy8rYqJAYzA5vWjfk-3ByQ-U_RFVRZ6fBxkboJomuSuFL-a9-HgCk_5W-0Vr8C_pAgrNpH4E6gofSPSkKUD874tc1DTGSs8oMpHPlnltXayjHTo8moFuNo4rBTeYkOlBXB2fUE1NYoADyjMotfEBmpT4FbcfGiG2FOm')"></div>
<div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
<div class="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-primary/20 shadow-sm">

<button class="w-full h-touch-target-min bg-primary text-on-primary rounded-lg font-title-lg text-title-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all shadow-md">
            Lanjutkan
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined">chevron_right</span>
</button>
</footer>
<!-- Interactive Logic (Simple simulation of cascading dependency) -->
<script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const selects = document.querySelectorAll('select');
            
            selects.forEach(select => {
                select.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                    // Visual feedback for selection
                    const parent = e.target.closest('.group');
                    parent.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        parent.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20');
                    }, 400);
                });
            });

            // Handle primary button click
            const mainBtn = document.querySelector('button.bg-primary');
            mainBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const btnContent = mainBtn.innerHTML;
                mainBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">progress_activity</span> Memproses...';
                mainBtn.disabled = true;
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    mainBtn.innerHTML = btnContent;
                    mainBtn.disabled = false;
                }, 1500);
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interactions for navigation
        const navButtons = document.querySelectorAll('nav button');
        navButtons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                navButtons.forEach(b => {
                    b.classList.remove('bg-secondary-container', 'text-on-secondary-container', 'rounded-xl', 'px-stack-md', 'py-stack-sm', 'active-nav-glow');
                    b.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant', 'p-stack-sm');
                    const icon = b.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
                    if(icon) icon.style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 0";
                });
                btn.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant', 'p-stack-sm');
                btn.classList.add('bg-secondary-container', 'text-on-secondary-container', 'rounded-xl', 'px-stack-md', 'py-stack-sm', 'active-nav-glow');
                const activeIcon = btn.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
                if(activeIcon) activeIcon.style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 1";
            });
        });

        // Simple haptic-like effect on activity cards
        const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.group');
        cards.forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('touchstart', () => card.style.transform = 'scale(0.98)');
            card.addEventListener('touchend', () => card.style.transform = 'scale(1)');
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Simple search filtering logic simulation
        const searchInput = document.querySelector('input[type="text"]');
        const cards = document.querySelectorAll('main section:last-of-type > div[class*="bg-surface-container-lowest"]');

        searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            const query = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
            cards.forEach(card => {
                const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
                if (text.includes(query)) {
                    card.style.display = 'flex';
                } else {
                    card.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
        });

        // Chip selection simulation
        const chips = document.querySelectorAll('.flex.gap-2.overflow-x-auto button');
        chips.forEach(chip => {
            chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
                chips.forEach(c => {
                    c.classList.remove('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary');
                    c.classList.add('bg-surface-container-high', 'text-on-surface-variant');
                });
                chip.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-high', 'text-on-surface-variant');
                chip.classList.add('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for the progress bar
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progress-bar');
            let progress = 0;
            
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                progress += Math.random() * 15;
                if (progress >= 100) {
                    progress = 100;
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    // Potential navigation logic would go here
                    console.log("System Ready");
                }
                progressBar.style.width = `${progress}%`;
            }, 300);
        });

        // Add subtle mouse-tracking movement to the background glow
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const glow = document.querySelector('.blur-3xl');
            if (glow) {
                const moveX = (e.clientX - window.innerWidth / 2) / 50;
                const moveY = (e.clientY - window.innerHeight / 2) / 50;
                glow.style.transform = `translate(${moveX}px, ${moveY}px) scale(1.5)`;
            }
        });
    </script>

<script>
        function selectPriority(btn) {
            const container = btn.parentElement;
            const buttons = container.querySelectorAll('button');
            buttons.forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('segmented-control-active');
                b.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant');
            });
            btn.classList.add('segmented-control-active');
            btn.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant');
            
            // Add haptic-like feedback animation
            btn.classList.add('scale-105');
            setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('scale-105'), 100);
        }

        // Micro-interaction: Form Field Focus
        const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input, select');
        inputs.forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                input.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('translate-x-1');
                input.parentElement.parentElement.style.transition = 'all 0.2s ease';
            });
            input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                input.parentElement.parentElement.classList.remove('translate-x-1');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Simple micro-interaction for radio cards
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                document.querySelectorAll('input[name="hasil"]').forEach(r => {
                    r.closest('label').classList.remove('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
                    r.closest('label').classList.add('border-outline-variant', 'bg-surface-container-lowest');
                });
                if(e.target.checked) {
                    e.target.closest('label').classList.add('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
                    e.target.closest('label').classList.remove('border-outline-variant', 'bg-surface-container-lowest');
                }
            });
        });

        // Initialize checked state style
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');
            if(checked) {
                checked.closest('label').classList.add('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
                checked.closest('label').classList.remove('border-outline-variant', 'bg-surface-container-lowest');
            }
        });
    </script>

<!-- Script for Interactions -->
<script>
        function toggleCard(id) {
            const card = document.getElementById(id);
            const isExpanded = card.classList.contains('card-expanded');
            
            // Close others (optional based on UX preference, here we allow multiple)
            // document.querySelectorAll('.card-item').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('card-expanded'));
            
            if (isExpanded) {
                card.classList.remove('card-expanded');
            } else {
                card.classList.add('card-expanded');
            }
        }

        function selectOption(btn) {
            // Find all buttons in the same container
            const container = btn.parentElement;
            const buttons = container.querySelectorAll('button');
            
            buttons.forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('segmented-button-active');
                b.querySelector('span.material-symbols-outlined').style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 0";
            });
            
            btn.classList.add('segmented-button-active');
            btn.querySelector('span.material-symbols-outlined').style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 1";

            // Update card border to highlight completion
            const card = btn.closest('.card-item');
            card.classList.replace('border-outline-variant', 'border-primary');
        }

        // Initialize first button of the first card as active for visual demo
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const firstCardBtn = document.querySelector('#card-1 .grid button');
            if (firstCardBtn) selectOption(firstCardBtn);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<canvas class="confetti-canvas" id="confetti"></canvas>
<script>
        // Simple micro-interaction for success splash
        const canvas = document.getElementById('confetti');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        let particles = [];

        function resize() {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
        resize();

        class Particle {
            constructor() {
                this.x = canvas.width / 2;
                this.y = canvas.height / 2;
                this.size = Math.random() * 8 + 4;
                this.speedX = Math.random() * 10 - 5;
                this.speedY = Math.random() * -10 - 5;
                this.gravity = 0.2;
                this.color = ['#004581', '#fed000', '#ba1a1a', '#005daa'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
                this.life = 100;
            }
            update() {
                this.speedY += this.gravity;
                this.x += this.speedX;
                this.y += this.speedY;
                this.life -= 1.5;
            }
            draw() {
                ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
                ctx.globalAlpha = this.life / 100;
                ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.size, this.size);
            }
        }

        function burst() {
            for(let i=0; i<50; i++) {
                particles.push(new Particle());
            }
        }

        function animate() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            for(let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
                particles[i].update();
                particles[i].draw();
                if(particles[i].life <= 0) {
                    particles.splice(i, 1);
                    i--;
                }
            }
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        // Trigger on load
        setTimeout(() => {
            burst();
            animate();
        }, 300);

        // Interactive ripple effect on buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('button, a').forEach(el => {
            el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                let x = e.clientX - e.target.offsetLeft;
                let y = e.clientY - e.target.offsetTop;
                let ripple = document.createElement('span');
                ripple.style.position = 'absolute';
                ripple.style.left = x + 'px';
                ripple.style.top = y + 'px';
                ripple.classList.add('ripple');
                // Normally would add CSS for ripple but keeping it simple for stability
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<div class="w-20 h-20 bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-stack-md">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[48px]" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">check_circle</span>
</div>
<h3 class="font-headline-sm text-on-surface">HAR Berhasil Diajukan</h3>
<p class="font-body-md text-on-surface-variant mt-2 mb-stack-lg">Laporan HAR Anda telah terkirim ke supervisor untuk diverifikasi.</p>
<button class="w-full h-touch-target-min bg-primary text-white rounded-lg font-title-lg" onclick="closeOverlay()">Kembali ke Beranda</button>
</div>
</div>
<script>
        function submitHAR() {
            const checkbox = document.getElementById('agree');
            if (!checkbox.checked) {
                alert('Silakan centang pernyataan persetujuan terlebih dahulu.');
                checkbox.parentElement.classList.add('animate-pulse');
                setTimeout(() => checkbox.parentElement.classList.remove('animate-pulse'), 1000);
                return;
            }
            document.getElementById('successOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('successOverlay').classList.add('flex');
        }

        function closeOverlay() {
            document.getElementById('successOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('successOverlay').classList.remove('flex');
        }

        // Interactivity for checkbox visual feedback
        const agreeCheckbox = document.getElementById('agree');
        agreeCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
            const container = this.closest('div.bg-surface-container-low');
            if(this.checked) {
                container.classList.remove('border-primary-fixed');
                container.classList.add('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
            } else {
                container.classList.add('border-primary-fixed');
                container.classList.remove('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

                if(this.classList.contains('bg-surface-container-high')) {
                    this.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-high', 'text-on-surface-variant');
                    this.classList.add('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary-container', 'border-primary');
                } else if (this.classList.contains('bg-primary-container')) {
                   // Only toggle if it's a filter chip (not the date range one which we keep active by default for demo)
                   if(this.innerText.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'date range') {
                        this.classList.add('bg-surface-container-high', 'text-on-surface-variant');
                        this.classList.remove('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary-container', 'border-primary');
                   }
                }
            });
        });

<script>
        function toggleFilter(btn) {
            const buttons = btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('button');
            buttons.forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('active-filter');
                b.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
            });
            btn.classList.add('active-filter');
            btn.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
            
            // Micro-interaction for haptic-like feel
            btn.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            }, 100);
        }

        // Add smooth list item interaction
        document.querySelectorAll('.cursor-pointer').forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Dim the unread indicator if it exists
                const indicator = item.querySelector('.unread-indicator');
                if (indicator) {
                    indicator.style.opacity = '0';
                    item.classList.replace('border-primary', 'border-outline-variant');
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

            btn.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
                this.classList.remove('opacity-70');
            });
        });
    </script>

<script>
        function toggleFilter(btn) {
            const buttons = btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('button');
            buttons.forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('active-filter');
                b.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
            });
            btn.classList.add('active-filter');
            btn.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
            
            // Micro-interaction for haptic-like feel
            btn.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            }, 100);
        }

        // Add smooth list item interaction
        document.querySelectorAll('.cursor-pointer').forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Dim the unread indicator if it exists
                const indicator = item.querySelector('.unread-indicator');
                if (indicator) {
                    indicator.style.opacity = '0';
                    item.classList.replace('border-primary', 'border-outline-variant');
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

                    this.classList.add('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary-container', 'border-primary');

<script>
        function submitHAR() {
            const checkbox = document.getElementById('agree');
            if (!checkbox.checked) {
                alert('Silakan centang pernyataan persetujuan terlebih dahulu.');
                checkbox.parentElement.classList.add('animate-pulse');
                setTimeout(() => checkbox.parentElement.classList.remove('animate-pulse'), 1000);
                return;
            }
            document.getElementById('successOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('successOverlay').classList.add('flex');
        }

        function closeOverlay() {
            document.getElementById('successOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('successOverlay').classList.remove('flex');
        }

        // Interactivity for checkbox visual feedback
        const agreeCheckbox = document.getElementById('agree');
        agreeCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
            const container = this.closest('div.bg-surface-container-low');
            if(this.checked) {
                container.classList.remove('border-primary-fixed');
                container.classList.add('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
            } else {
                container.classList.add('border-primary-fixed');
                container.classList.remove('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
            }
        });
    </script>

<canvas class="confetti-canvas" id="confetti"></canvas>
<script>
        // Simple micro-interaction for success splash
        const canvas = document.getElementById('confetti');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        let particles = [];

        function resize() {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
        resize();

        class Particle {
            constructor() {
                this.x = canvas.width / 2;
                this.y = canvas.height / 2;
                this.size = Math.random() * 8 + 4;
                this.speedX = Math.random() * 10 - 5;
                this.speedY = Math.random() * -10 - 5;
                this.gravity = 0.2;
                this.color = ['#004581', '#fed000', '#ba1a1a', '#005daa'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
                this.life = 100;
            }
            update() {
                this.speedY += this.gravity;
                this.x += this.speedX;
                this.y += this.speedY;
                this.life -= 1.5;
            }
            draw() {
                ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
                ctx.globalAlpha = this.life / 100;
                ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.size, this.size);
            }
        }

        function burst() {
            for(let i=0; i<50; i++) {
                particles.push(new Particle());
            }
        }

        function animate() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            for(let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
                particles[i].update();
                particles[i].draw();
                if(particles[i].life <= 0) {
                    particles.splice(i, 1);
                    i--;
                }
            }
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        // Trigger on load
        setTimeout(() => {
            burst();
            animate();
        }, 300);

        // Interactive ripple effect on buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('button, a').forEach(el => {
            el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                let x = e.clientX - e.target.offsetLeft;
                let y = e.clientY - e.target.offsetTop;
                let ripple = document.createElement('span');
                ripple.style.position = 'absolute';
                ripple.style.left = x + 'px';
                ripple.style.top = y + 'px';
                ripple.classList.add('ripple');
                // Normally would add CSS for ripple but keeping it simple for stability
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const ripple = document.createElement('div');
                ripple.classList.add('ripple');
                this.appendChild(ripple);
                setTimeout(() => ripple.remove(), 600);
            });
        });

<span class="absolute right-4 material-symbols-outlined text-error">warning</span>
</label>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Bottom Navigation Shell (Filter Applied: Transactional focused, but navigation exists for global context) -->
<nav class="fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full z-30 flex justify-around items-center h-[80px] px-base pb-safe bg-surface-container shadow-md hidden">

</div>

</div>

<!-- Image Interaction & Atmospheric effects -->
<script>
        // Simple micro-interaction for radio cards
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                document.querySelectorAll('input[name="hasil"]').forEach(r => {
                    r.closest('label').classList.remove('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
                    r.closest('label').classList.add('border-outline-variant', 'bg-surface-container-lowest');
                });
                if(e.target.checked) {
                    e.target.closest('label').classList.add('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
                    e.target.closest('label').classList.remove('border-outline-variant', 'bg-surface-container-lowest');
                }
            });
        });

        // Initialize checked state style
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');
            if(checked) {
                checked.closest('label').classList.add('border-primary', 'bg-primary-fixed/20');
                checked.closest('label').classList.remove('border-outline-variant', 'bg-surface-container-lowest');
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<span class="material-symbols-outlined" data-icon="arrow_forward">arrow_forward</span>
</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Script for Interactions -->
<script>
        function toggleCard(id) {
            const card = document.getElementById(id);
            const isExpanded = card.classList.contains('card-expanded');
            
            // Close others (optional based on UX preference, here we allow multiple)
            // document.querySelectorAll('.card-item').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('card-expanded'));
            
            if (isExpanded) {
                card.classList.remove('card-expanded');
            } else {
                card.classList.add('card-expanded');
            }
        }

        function selectOption(btn) {
            // Find all buttons in the same container
            const container = btn.parentElement;
            const buttons = container.querySelectorAll('button');
            
            buttons.forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('segmented-button-active');
                b.querySelector('span.material-symbols-outlined').style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 0";
            });
            
            btn.classList.add('segmented-button-active');
            btn.querySelector('span.material-symbols-outlined').style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 1";

            // Update card border to highlight completion
            const card = btn.closest('.card-item');
            card.classList.replace('border-outline-variant', 'border-primary');
        }

        // Initialize first button of the first card as active for visual demo
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const firstCardBtn = document.querySelector('#card-1 .grid button');
            if (firstCardBtn) selectOption(firstCardBtn);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<svg fill="none" height="400" viewbox="0 0 400 400" width="400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<circle class="text-primary" cx="350" cy="50" r="150" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="20"></circle>
<circle class="text-primary" cx="350" cy="50" r="250" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1"></circle>
</svg>

<script>
        function selectPriority(btn) {
            const container = btn.parentElement;
            const buttons = container.querySelectorAll('button');
            buttons.forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('segmented-control-active');
                b.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant');
            });
            btn.classList.add('segmented-control-active');
            btn.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant');
            
            // Add haptic-like feedback animation
            btn.classList.add('scale-105');
            setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('scale-105'), 100);
        }

        // Micro-interaction: Form Field Focus
        const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input, select');
        inputs.forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                input.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('translate-x-1');
                input.parentElement.parentElement.style.transition = 'all 0.2s ease';
            });
            input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                input.parentElement.parentElement.classList.remove('translate-x-1');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Simple search filtering logic simulation
        const searchInput = document.querySelector('input[type="text"]');
        const cards = document.querySelectorAll('main section:last-of-type > div[class*="bg-surface-container-lowest"]');

        searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            const query = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
            cards.forEach(card => {
                const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
                if (text.includes(query)) {
                    card.style.display = 'flex';
                } else {
                    card.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
        });

        // Chip selection simulation
        const chips = document.querySelectorAll('.flex.gap-2.overflow-x-auto button');
        chips.forEach(chip => {
            chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
                chips.forEach(c => {
                    c.classList.remove('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary');
                    c.classList.add('bg-surface-container-high', 'text-on-surface-variant');
                });
                chip.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-high', 'text-on-surface-variant');
                chip.classList.add('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interactions for navigation
        const navButtons = document.querySelectorAll('nav button');
        navButtons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                navButtons.forEach(b => {
                    b.classList.remove('bg-secondary-container', 'text-on-secondary-container', 'rounded-xl', 'px-stack-md', 'py-stack-sm', 'active-nav-glow');
                    b.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant', 'p-stack-sm');
                    const icon = b.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
                    if(icon) icon.style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 0";
                });
                btn.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant', 'p-stack-sm');
                btn.classList.add('bg-secondary-container', 'text-on-secondary-container', 'rounded-xl', 'px-stack-md', 'py-stack-sm', 'active-nav-glow');
                const activeIcon = btn.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
                if(activeIcon) activeIcon.style.fontVariationSettings = "'FILL' 1";
            });
        });

        // Simple haptic-like effect on activity cards
        const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.group');
        cards.forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('touchstart', () => card.style.transform = 'scale(0.98)');
            card.addEventListener('touchend', () => card.style.transform = 'scale(1)');
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for the progress bar
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progress-bar');
            let progress = 0;
            
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                progress += Math.random() * 15;
                if (progress >= 100) {
                    progress = 100;
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    // Potential navigation logic would go here
                    console.log("System Ready");
                }
                progressBar.style.width = `${progress}%`;
            }, 300);
        });

        // Add subtle mouse-tracking movement to the background glow
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const glow = document.querySelector('.blur-3xl');
            if (glow) {
                const moveX = (e.clientX - window.innerWidth / 2) / 50;
                const moveY = (e.clientY - window.innerHeight / 2) / 50;
                glow.style.transform = `translate(${moveX}px, ${moveY}px) scale(1.5)`;
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<!-- Interactive Logic (Simple simulation of cascading dependency) -->
<script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const selects = document.querySelectorAll('select');
            
            selects.forEach(select => {
                select.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                    // Visual feedback for selection
                    const parent = e.target.closest('.group');
                    parent.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        parent.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20');
                    }, 400);
                });
            });

            // Handle primary button click
            const mainBtn = document.querySelector('button.bg-primary');
            mainBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const btnContent = mainBtn.innerHTML;
                mainBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">progress_activity</span> Memproses...';
                mainBtn.disabled = true;
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    mainBtn.innerHTML = btnContent;
                    mainBtn.disabled = false;
                }, 1500);
            });
        });
    </script>

<script>

        const togglePassword = document.getElementById('togglePassword');
        const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
        
        togglePassword.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const type = passwordInput.getAttribute('type') === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
            passwordInput.setAttribute('type', type);
            
            const icon = this.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
            if (type === 'text') {
                icon.textContent = 'visibility_off';
                icon.setAttribute('data-icon', 'visibility_off');
            } else {
                icon.textContent = 'visibility';
                icon.setAttribute('data-icon', 'visibility');
            }
        });

        // Simple button ripple/active state handling
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('mousedown', function() {
                this.style.opacity = '0.9';
            });
            button.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
                this.style.opacity = '1';
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

            drawer.classList.toggle('-translate-x-full');
            overlay.classList.toggle('hidden');

        menuBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleDrawer);
        overlay.addEventListener('click', toggleDrawer);

        // Simple Tab Logic
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('nav button');
        tabs.forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('tab-active', 'text-primary'));
                tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant'));
                tab.classList.add('tab-active', 'text-primary');

<button class="flex-1 py-4 text-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-low transition-colors">
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps">PREVENTION</span>
</button>
</div>
<!-- Event Form Section -->
<section class="space-y-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">history_edu</span>
<h2 class="text-headline-sm font-headline-sm">Record Maintenance Event</h2>
</div>
<form class="space-y-5 bg-surface-container-lowest p-6 rounded-xl border border-outline-variant shadow-sm">
<!-- Row 1: Type & Machine -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">EVENT TYPE</label>
<div class="relative">
<select class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary appearance-none transition-all">
<option>Corrective Maintenance</option>
<option>Breakdown Repair</option>
<option>Emergency Shutdown</option>
<option>Instrument Failure</option>
</select>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-3 top-3 pointer-events-none text-outline">arrow_drop_down</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">UNIT / MACHINE</label>
<div class="relative">
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" type="text" value="Unit 1 - Boiler Feed Pump"/>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-3 top-3 text-outline">precision_manufacturing</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Row 2: Date -->
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">DATE & TIME OF DISCOVERY</label>
<div class="relative">
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" type="datetime-local"/>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-3 top-3 pointer-events-none text-outline">calendar_today</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Description -->
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">DETAILED DESCRIPTION</label>
<textarea class="w-full h-32 p-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all resize-none" placeholder="Describe the findings and immediate observations..."></textarea>
</div>
<!-- Impact & Downtime -->
<div class="p-4 bg-error-container/30 rounded-lg border border-error/20 space-y-4">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-error">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">warning</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps font-bold">OPERATIONAL IMPACT</span>
</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant">IMPACT LEVEL</label>
<select class="w-full h-10 px-3 bg-white border border-outline-variant rounded-lg focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary">
<option>High - Unit Trip</option>
<option>Medium - Derating</option>
<option>Low - No Impact</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant">EST. DOWNTIME (HRS)</label>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<input class="w-full h-10 px-3 bg-white border border-outline-variant rounded-lg font-data-mono text-data-mono" placeholder="0.0" type="number"/>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant">HRS</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Root Cause & Action -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">INITIAL ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS</label>
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" placeholder="Identify the source of failure..." type="text"/>
</div>
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">IMMEDIATE ACTION TAKEN</label>
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" placeholder="Describe temporary or permanent fix..." type="text"/>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Media Upload Placeholder -->
<div class="pt-2">
<div class="border-2 border-dashed border-outline-variant rounded-xl p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-all cursor-pointer">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-4xl mb-2">add_a_photo</span>
<span class="font-bold">Attach Field Evidence</span>
<span class="text-body-sm font-body-sm opacity-70">JPG, PNG (Max 5MB)</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Submit Button -->
<button class="w-full bg-primary text-on-primary h-14 rounded-full font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform" type="submit">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">save</span>
                    RECORD EVENT
                </button>
</form>
</section>
<!-- Informational Card (Bento Style) -->
<div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
<div class="bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container p-5 rounded-2xl flex gap-4 items-start shadow-sm">
<div class="bg-primary rounded-lg p-2 text-on-primary shrink-0">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">info</span>
</div>
<div>
<h3 class="font-bold mb-1">Standard Operating Procedure</h3>
<p class="text-body-sm font-body-sm opacity-90 leading-relaxed">
                        Every event must be recorded within 30 minutes of occurrence. Ensure "Initial Root Cause" matches the failure code in the physical logbook for synchronization.
                    </p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</main>
<!-- BottomNavBar -->
<nav class="fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 flex justify-around items-center h-20 w-full px-2 bg-surface border-t border-outline-variant shadow-lg">
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">dashboard</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Dashboard</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">description</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Logsheet</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container rounded-full px-4 py-1 active:scale-90 transition-transform" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">engineering</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps">HAR</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">assignment</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Job Card</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">person</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Profil</span>
</a>
</nav>
<!-- Simple Feedback Toast (Hidden) -->
<div class="fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-inverse-surface text-inverse-on-surface px-6 py-3 rounded-full shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-3 opacity-0 translate-y-4 transition-all duration-300 pointer-events-none" id="toast">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary-fixed-dim">check_circle</span>
<span class="font-bold">Event Logged Successfully</span>
</div>
<script>
        // Form Submission micro-interaction
        document.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4', 'pointer-events-none');
            toast.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4', 'pointer-events-none');
                toast.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
            }, 3000);
        });

        // Tab Switching micro-interaction (Visual only)
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.flex.border-b button');
        tabs.forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                tabs.forEach(t => {
                    t.classList.remove('text-primary', 'font-bold');
                    t.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant');
                    const indicator = t.querySelector('.active-tab-indicator');
                    if(indicator) indicator.remove();
                });
                tab.classList.add('text-primary', 'font-bold');
                tab.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant');
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'active-tab-indicator bg-primary';
                tab.appendChild(div);
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
                            const gridContainer = document.currentScript.parentElement;
                            for(let i=1; i<=24; i++) {
                                let statusColor = "bg-secondary-container";
                                if (i > 19 && i <= 22) statusColor = "bg-tertiary";
                                if (i > 22) statusColor = "bg-error";
                                
                                const cell = document.createElement('div');
                                cell.className = `${statusColor} h-12 flex items-center justify-center rounded text-xs font-bold text-on-background opacity-90 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity cursor-pointer group relative`;
                                cell.innerHTML = `U${i.toString().padStart(2, '0')}<div class="absolute -top-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-on-background text-on-primary text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded hidden group-hover:block whitespace-nowrap z-10">Unit ${i} Status: ${i>22?'Critical':i>19?'Pending':'Operational'}</div>`;
                                gridContainer.appendChild(cell);
                            }
                        </script>

<script>
        // Real-time validation logic
        const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="number"]');
        
        inputs.forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('input', function() {
                const val = parseFloat(this.value);
                const min = parseFloat(this.dataset.min);
                const max = parseFloat(this.dataset.max);
                const container = this.closest('.log-input-focus');
                const warningMsg = container.querySelector('.text-error');

                if (!isNaN(val)) {
                    if (val < min || val > max) {
                        // Warning State
                        container.classList.add('bg-error-container');
                        container.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-lowest');
                        if(warningMsg) warningMsg.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        // Normal State
                        container.classList.remove('bg-error-container');
                        container.classList.add('bg-surface-container-lowest');
                        if(warningMsg) warningMsg.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                } else {
                    container.classList.remove('bg-error-container');
                    container.classList.add('bg-surface-container-lowest');
                    if(warningMsg) warningMsg.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            });
        });

        // Submit Action
        document.getElementById('submitBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
            const originalContent = btn.innerHTML;
            
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">sync</span> Submitting...';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                alert('Logsheet for PLTD Batu Ampar #01 has been submitted successfully.');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = originalContent;
            }, 1500);
        });

        // Micro-interaction for input containers
        document.querySelectorAll('.log-input-focus input').forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                input.closest('.log-input-focus').classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20');
            });
            input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                input.closest('.log-input-focus').classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for hover states
        document.querySelectorAll('.glass-card').forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                card.classList.add('shadow-md');
                card.style.transform = 'translateY(-2px)';
                card.style.transition = 'all 0.2s ease-out';
            });
            card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                card.classList.remove('shadow-md');
                card.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
            });
        });

        // Simple Active Navigation logic based on the prompt's focus
        // Dashboard is currently active as mapped in the HTML.

</nav>
<script>
        // Micro-interaction for buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                let ripple = document.createElement('span');
                ripple.classList.add('ripple');
                this.appendChild(ripple);
                let x = e.clientX - e.target.offsetLeft;
                let y = e.clientY - e.target.offsetTop;
                ripple.style.left = `${x}px`;
                ripple.style.top = `${y}px`;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ripple.remove();
                }, 600);
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

        function toggleDrawer() {
            drawer.classList.toggle('-translate-x-full');
            overlay.classList.toggle('hidden');
        }

        menuBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleDrawer);
        overlay.addEventListener('click', toggleDrawer);

        // Simple Tab Logic
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('nav button');
        tabs.forEach(tab => {

                tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('tab-active', 'text-primary'));

                tab.classList.add('tab-active', 'text-primary');

            });

<body class="bg-surface text-on-surface font-body-md antialiased">

<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
<label class="font-body-sm font-semibold text-on-surface">Stand KWh</label>
<span class="font-data-mono text-[10px] text-outline">Accumulative</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center">
<input class="w-full bg-transparent border-none p-0 focus:ring-0 font-data-mono text-xl" placeholder="00000.00" step="0.01" type="number"/>

</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Mechanical Parameters -->
<div class="space-y-3">

<nav class="fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 flex justify-around items-center h-20 px-2 bg-surface border-t border-outline-variant shadow-lg">
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high rounded-full px-4 py-1 transition-transform scale-95 active:scale-90" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">dashboard</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">Dashboard</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container rounded-full px-4 py-1 transition-transform scale-95 active:scale-90" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">description</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">Logsheet</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high rounded-full px-4 py-1 transition-transform scale-95 active:scale-90" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">engineering</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">HAR</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high rounded-full px-4 py-1 transition-transform scale-95 active:scale-90" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">assignment</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">Job Card</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high rounded-full px-4 py-1 transition-transform scale-95 active:scale-90" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">person</span>
<span class="font-label-caps text-label-caps">Profil</span>
</a>
</nav>
<script>
        // Real-time validation logic
        const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="number"]');
        
        inputs.forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('input', function() {
                const val = parseFloat(this.value);
                const min = parseFloat(this.dataset.min);
                const max = parseFloat(this.dataset.max);
                const container = this.closest('.log-input-focus');
                const warningMsg = container.querySelector('.text-error');

                if (!isNaN(val)) {
                    if (val < min || val > max) {
                        // Warning State
                        container.classList.add('bg-error-container');
                        container.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-lowest');
                        if(warningMsg) warningMsg.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        // Normal State
                        container.classList.remove('bg-error-container');
                        container.classList.add('bg-surface-container-lowest');
                        if(warningMsg) warningMsg.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                } else {
                    container.classList.remove('bg-error-container');
                    container.classList.add('bg-surface-container-lowest');
                    if(warningMsg) warningMsg.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            });
        });

        // Submit Action
        document.getElementById('submitBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
            const originalContent = btn.innerHTML;
            
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin">sync</span> Submitting...';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                alert('Logsheet for PLTD Batu Ampar #01 has been submitted successfully.');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = originalContent;
            }, 1500);
        });

        // Micro-interaction for input containers
        document.querySelectorAll('.log-input-focus input').forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                input.closest('.log-input-focus').classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20');
            });
            input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                input.closest('.log-input-focus').classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary/20');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>
