<!DOCTYPE html>

<html class="light" lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>Event & Prevention - HAR Mobile</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com?plugins=forms,container-queries"></script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@100..900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
        .material-symbols-outlined {
            font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 0, 'wght' 400, 'GRAD' 0, 'opsz' 24;
        }
        .active-tab-indicator {
            height: 3px;
            width: 100%;
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
        }
        /* Custom scrollbar for better industrial look */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #f8f9ff; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #c1c6d3; border-radius: 3px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #727782; }
    </style>
<script id="tailwind-config">
        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: "class",
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    "colors": {
                        "surface": "#f8f9ff",
                        "error": "#ba1a1a",
                        "on-secondary-fixed": "#231b00",
                        "on-background": "#0b1c30",
                        "tertiary-fixed-dim": "#ffb68d",
                        "tertiary-container": "#974401",
                        "surface-container-low": "#eff4ff",
                        "on-primary": "#ffffff",
                        "on-error": "#ffffff",
                        "primary": "#004581",
                        "secondary": "#725c00",
                        "outline": "#727782",
                        "inverse-surface": "#213145",
                        "surface-container": "#e5eeff",
                        "surface-container-lowest": "#ffffff",
                        "primary-fixed": "#d4e3ff",
                        "on-tertiary": "#ffffff",
                        "outline-variant": "#c1c6d3",
                        "secondary-container": "#fed000",
                        "on-primary-fixed-variant": "#004785",
                        "background": "#f8f9ff",
                        "on-secondary": "#ffffff",
                        "primary-container": "#005daa",
                        "surface-variant": "#d3e4fe",
                        "surface-bright": "#f8f9ff",
                        "on-tertiary-fixed-variant": "#763300",
                        "inverse-on-surface": "#eaf1ff",
                        "primary-fixed-dim": "#a5c8ff",
                        "surface-dim": "#cbdbf5",
                        "tertiary": "#733200",
                        "inverse-primary": "#a5c8ff",
                        "on-surface": "#0b1c30",
                        "secondary-fixed-dim": "#edc200",
                        "on-tertiary-container": "#ffcaad",
                        "surface-tint": "#075fac",
                        "error-container": "#ffdad6",
                        "secondary-fixed": "#ffe07f",
                        "on-secondary-container": "#6f5900",
                        "surface-container-high": "#dce9ff",
                        "on-error-container": "#93000a",
                        "on-secondary-fixed-variant": "#564500",
                        "on-primary-container": "#bed7ff",
                        "on-primary-fixed": "#001c3a",
                        "surface-container-highest": "#d3e4fe",
                        "on-tertiary-fixed": "#331200",
                        "on-surface-variant": "#414751",
                        "tertiary-fixed": "#ffdbc9"
                    },
                    "borderRadius": {
                        "DEFAULT": "0.125rem",
                        "lg": "0.25rem",
                        "xl": "0.5rem",
                        "full": "0.75rem"
                    },
                    "spacing": {
                        "margin-desktop": "32px",
                        "max-width": "1440px",
                        "margin-mobile": "16px",
                        "gutter": "16px",
                        "unit": "4px"
                    },
                    "fontFamily": {
                        "body-sm": ["IBM Plex Sans"],
                        "label-caps": ["IBM Plex Sans"],
                        "headline-md": ["IBM Plex Sans"],
                        "headline-sm": ["IBM Plex Sans"],
                        "body-md": ["IBM Plex Sans"],
                        "data-mono": ["JetBrains Mono"],
                        "display-lg": ["IBM Plex Sans"]
                    },
                    "fontSize": {
                        "body-sm": ["14px", {"lineHeight": "20px", "fontWeight": "400"}],
                        "label-caps": ["12px", {"lineHeight": "16px", "letterSpacing": "0.05em", "fontWeight": "700"}],
                        "headline-md": ["24px", {"lineHeight": "32px", "fontWeight": "600"}],
                        "headline-sm": ["20px", {"lineHeight": "28px", "fontWeight": "600"}],
                        "body-md": ["16px", {"lineHeight": "24px", "fontWeight": "400"}],
                        "data-mono": ["14px", {"lineHeight": "20px", "fontWeight": "500"}],
                        "display-lg": ["32px", {"lineHeight": "40px", "letterSpacing": "-0.02em", "fontWeight": "700"}]
                    }
                },
            },
        }
    </script>
<style>
    body {
      min-height: max(884px, 100dvh);
    }
  </style>
  </head>
<body class="bg-surface text-on-surface font-body-md min-h-screen pb-24">
<!-- TopAppBar -->
<header class="fixed top-0 w-full z-50 flex justify-between items-center px-4 h-16 w-full bg-surface border-b border-outline-variant">
<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
<button class="p-2 hover:bg-surface-container rounded-full transition-colors">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary">menu</span>
</button>
<h1 class="font-headline-md text-headline-md text-primary font-bold">HAR Mobile</h1>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<button class="p-2 hover:bg-surface-container rounded-full transition-colors">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary">notifications</span>
</button>
</div>
</header>
<main class="pt-20 px-4 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
<!-- Tab Navigation -->
<div class="flex border-b border-outline-variant mb-6 bg-surface sticky top-16 z-40">
<button class="flex-1 py-4 text-center relative font-bold text-primary">
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps">EVENT</span>
<div class="active-tab-indicator bg-primary"></div>
</button>
<button class="flex-1 py-4 text-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-low transition-colors">
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps">PREVENTION</span>
</button>
</div>
<!-- Event Form Section -->
<section class="space-y-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">history_edu</span>
<h2 class="text-headline-sm font-headline-sm">Record Maintenance Event</h2>
</div>
<form class="space-y-5 bg-surface-container-lowest p-6 rounded-xl border border-outline-variant shadow-sm">
<!-- Row 1: Type & Machine -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">EVENT TYPE</label>
<div class="relative">
<select class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary appearance-none transition-all">
<option>Corrective Maintenance</option>
<option>Breakdown Repair</option>
<option>Emergency Shutdown</option>
<option>Instrument Failure</option>
</select>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-3 top-3 pointer-events-none text-outline">arrow_drop_down</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">UNIT / MACHINE</label>
<div class="relative">
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" type="text" value="Unit 1 - Boiler Feed Pump"/>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-3 top-3 text-outline">precision_manufacturing</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Row 2: Date -->
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">DATE & TIME OF DISCOVERY</label>
<div class="relative">
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" type="datetime-local"/>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-3 top-3 pointer-events-none text-outline">calendar_today</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Description -->
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">DETAILED DESCRIPTION</label>
<textarea class="w-full h-32 p-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all resize-none" placeholder="Describe the findings and immediate observations..."></textarea>
</div>
<!-- Impact & Downtime -->
<div class="p-4 bg-error-container/30 rounded-lg border border-error/20 space-y-4">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-error">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">warning</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps font-bold">OPERATIONAL IMPACT</span>
</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant">IMPACT LEVEL</label>
<select class="w-full h-10 px-3 bg-white border border-outline-variant rounded-lg focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary">
<option>High - Unit Trip</option>
<option>Medium - Derating</option>
<option>Low - No Impact</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant">EST. DOWNTIME (HRS)</label>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<input class="w-full h-10 px-3 bg-white border border-outline-variant rounded-lg font-data-mono text-data-mono" placeholder="0.0" type="number"/>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant">HRS</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Root Cause & Action -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">INITIAL ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS</label>
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" placeholder="Identify the source of failure..." type="text"/>
</div>
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">IMMEDIATE ACTION TAKEN</label>
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" placeholder="Describe temporary or permanent fix..." type="text"/>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Media Upload Placeholder -->
<div class="pt-2">
<div class="border-2 border-dashed border-outline-variant rounded-xl p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-all cursor-pointer">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-4xl mb-2">add_a_photo</span>
<span class="font-bold">Attach Field Evidence</span>
<span class="text-body-sm font-body-sm opacity-70">JPG, PNG (Max 5MB)</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Submit Button -->
<button class="w-full bg-primary text-on-primary h-14 rounded-full font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform" type="submit">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">save</span>
                    RECORD EVENT
                </button>
</form>
</section>
<!-- Informational Card (Bento Style) -->
<div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
<div class="bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container p-5 rounded-2xl flex gap-4 items-start shadow-sm">
<div class="bg-primary rounded-lg p-2 text-on-primary shrink-0">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">info</span>
</div>
<div>
<h3 class="font-bold mb-1">Standard Operating Procedure</h3>
<p class="text-body-sm font-body-sm opacity-90 leading-relaxed">
                        Every event must be recorded within 30 minutes of occurrence. Ensure "Initial Root Cause" matches the failure code in the physical logbook for synchronization.
                    </p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</main>
<!-- BottomNavBar -->
<nav class="fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 flex justify-around items-center h-20 w-full px-2 bg-surface border-t border-outline-variant shadow-lg">
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">dashboard</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Dashboard</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">description</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Logsheet</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container rounded-full px-4 py-1 active:scale-90 transition-transform" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">engineering</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps">HAR</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">assignment</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Job Card</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">person</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Profil</span>
</a>
</nav>
<!-- Simple Feedback Toast (Hidden) -->
<div class="fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-inverse-surface text-inverse-on-surface px-6 py-3 rounded-full shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-3 opacity-0 translate-y-4 transition-all duration-300 pointer-events-none" id="toast">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary-fixed-dim">check_circle</span>
<span class="font-bold">Event Logged Successfully</span>
</div>
<script>
        // Form Submission micro-interaction
        document.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4', 'pointer-events-none');
            toast.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4', 'pointer-events-none');
                toast.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
            }, 3000);
        });

        // Tab Switching micro-interaction (Visual only)
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.flex.border-b button');
        tabs.forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                tabs.forEach(t => {
                    t.classList.remove('text-primary', 'font-bold');
                    t.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant');
                    const indicator = t.querySelector('.active-tab-indicator');
                    if(indicator) indicator.remove();
                });
                tab.classList.add('text-primary', 'font-bold');
                tab.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant');
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'active-tab-indicator bg-primary';
                tab.appendChild(div);
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for the "Update Progress" button
        document.querySelector('button:contains("Update Progress")')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
            console.log('Update progress triggered');
            // Mock interaction for demonstration
        });

        // Simple helper to find button by text since querySelector doesn't support :contains natively
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            if(btn.innerText.includes('Update Progress')) {
                btn.onclick = () => {
                   const feedback = document.createElement('div');
                   feedback.className = "fixed top-20 right-4 bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg z-[100] animate-bounce";
                   feedback.innerHTML = "Memuat logsheet terbaru...";
                   document.body.appendChild(feedback);
                   setTimeout(() => feedback.remove(), 2000);
                }
            }
        });
    </script>

        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                let ripple = document.createElement('span');
                ripple.classList.add('ripple');
                this.appendChild(ripple);
                let x = e.clientX - e.target.offsetLeft;
                let y = e.clientY - e.target.offsetTop;
                ripple.style.left = `${x}px`;
                ripple.style.top = `${y}px`;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ripple.remove();
                }, 600);
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {

                    btn.style.transform = originalScale;

        // Simple Micro-interaction for machine card clicks
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Subtle visual feedback
                const originalScale = btn.style.transform;
                btn.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.style.transform = originalScale;
                }, 100);

<script>
        // Micro-interaction for buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                let ripple = document.createElement('span');
                ripple.classList.add('ripple');
                this.appendChild(ripple);
                let x = e.clientX - e.target.offsetLeft;
                let y = e.clientY - e.target.offsetTop;
                ripple.style.left = `${x}px`;
                ripple.style.top = `${y}px`;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ripple.remove();
                }, 600);
            });
        });
    </script>

        document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {

                btn.onclick = () => {
                   const feedback = document.createElement('div');

<main class="pt-20 px-4 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
<!-- Tab Navigation -->
<div class="flex border-b border-outline-variant mb-6 bg-surface sticky top-16 z-40">
<button class="flex-1 py-4 text-center relative font-bold text-primary">
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps">EVENT</span>
<div class="active-tab-indicator bg-primary"></div>
</button>
<button class="flex-1 py-4 text-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-low transition-colors">
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps">PREVENTION</span>
</button>
</div>
<!-- Event Form Section -->
<section class="space-y-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">history_edu</span>
<h2 class="text-headline-sm font-headline-sm">Record Maintenance Event</h2>
</div>
<form class="space-y-5 bg-surface-container-lowest p-6 rounded-xl border border-outline-variant shadow-sm">
<!-- Row 1: Type & Machine -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">EVENT TYPE</label>
<div class="relative">
<select class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary appearance-none transition-all">
<option>Corrective Maintenance</option>
<option>Breakdown Repair</option>
<option>Emergency Shutdown</option>
<option>Instrument Failure</option>
</select>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-3 top-3 pointer-events-none text-outline">arrow_drop_down</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">UNIT / MACHINE</label>
<div class="relative">
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" type="text" value="Unit 1 - Boiler Feed Pump"/>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-3 top-3 text-outline">precision_manufacturing</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Row 2: Date -->
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">DATE & TIME OF DISCOVERY</label>
<div class="relative">
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" type="datetime-local"/>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute right-3 top-3 pointer-events-none text-outline">calendar_today</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Description -->
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">DETAILED DESCRIPTION</label>
<textarea class="w-full h-32 p-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all resize-none" placeholder="Describe the findings and immediate observations..."></textarea>
</div>
<!-- Impact & Downtime -->
<div class="p-4 bg-error-container/30 rounded-lg border border-error/20 space-y-4">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-error">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">warning</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps font-bold">OPERATIONAL IMPACT</span>
</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant">IMPACT LEVEL</label>
<select class="w-full h-10 px-3 bg-white border border-outline-variant rounded-lg focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary">
<option>High - Unit Trip</option>
<option>Medium - Derating</option>
<option>Low - No Impact</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant">EST. DOWNTIME (HRS)</label>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<input class="w-full h-10 px-3 bg-white border border-outline-variant rounded-lg font-data-mono text-data-mono" placeholder="0.0" type="number"/>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant">HRS</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Root Cause & Action -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">INITIAL ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS</label>
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" placeholder="Identify the source of failure..." type="text"/>
</div>
<div class="space-y-1.5">
<label class="text-label-caps font-label-caps text-on-surface-variant px-1">IMMEDIATE ACTION TAKEN</label>
<input class="w-full h-12 px-4 bg-surface border border-outline rounded-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all" placeholder="Describe temporary or permanent fix..." type="text"/>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Media Upload Placeholder -->
<div class="pt-2">
<div class="border-2 border-dashed border-outline-variant rounded-xl p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-all cursor-pointer">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-4xl mb-2">add_a_photo</span>
<span class="font-bold">Attach Field Evidence</span>
<span class="text-body-sm font-body-sm opacity-70">JPG, PNG (Max 5MB)</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Submit Button -->
<button class="w-full bg-primary text-on-primary h-14 rounded-full font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform" type="submit">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">save</span>
                    RECORD EVENT
                </button>
</form>
</section>
<!-- Informational Card (Bento Style) -->
<div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
<div class="bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container p-5 rounded-2xl flex gap-4 items-start shadow-sm">
<div class="bg-primary rounded-lg p-2 text-on-primary shrink-0">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">info</span>
</div>
<div>
<h3 class="font-bold mb-1">Standard Operating Procedure</h3>
<p class="text-body-sm font-body-sm opacity-90 leading-relaxed">
                        Every event must be recorded within 30 minutes of occurrence. Ensure "Initial Root Cause" matches the failure code in the physical logbook for synchronization.
                    </p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</main>
<!-- BottomNavBar -->
<nav class="fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 flex justify-around items-center h-20 w-full px-2 bg-surface border-t border-outline-variant shadow-lg">
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">dashboard</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Dashboard</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">description</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Logsheet</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container rounded-full px-4 py-1 active:scale-90 transition-transform" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1;">engineering</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps">HAR</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">assignment</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Job Card</span>
</a>
<a class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors p-2 rounded-xl" href="#">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined">person</span>
<span class="text-label-caps font-label-caps mt-1">Profil</span>
</a>
</nav>
<!-- Simple Feedback Toast (Hidden) -->
<div class="fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-inverse-surface text-inverse-on-surface px-6 py-3 rounded-full shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-3 opacity-0 translate-y-4 transition-all duration-300 pointer-events-none" id="toast">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary-fixed-dim">check_circle</span>
<span class="font-bold">Event Logged Successfully</span>
</div>
<script>
        // Form Submission micro-interaction
        document.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4', 'pointer-events-none');
            toast.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4', 'pointer-events-none');
                toast.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
            }, 3000);
        });

        // Tab Switching micro-interaction (Visual only)
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.flex.border-b button');
        tabs.forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                tabs.forEach(t => {
                    t.classList.remove('text-primary', 'font-bold');
                    t.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant');
                    const indicator = t.querySelector('.active-tab-indicator');
                    if(indicator) indicator.remove();
                });
                tab.classList.add('text-primary', 'font-bold');
                tab.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant');
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'active-tab-indicator bg-primary';
                tab.appendChild(div);
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
                            const gridContainer = document.currentScript.parentElement;
                            for(let i=1; i<=24; i++) {
                                let statusColor = "bg-secondary-container";
                                if (i > 19 && i <= 22) statusColor = "bg-tertiary";
                                if (i > 22) statusColor = "bg-error";
                                
                                const cell = document.createElement('div');
                                cell.className = `${statusColor} h-12 flex items-center justify-center rounded text-xs font-bold text-on-background opacity-90 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity cursor-pointer group relative`;
                                cell.innerHTML = `U${i.toString().padStart(2, '0')}<div class="absolute -top-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-on-background text-on-primary text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded hidden group-hover:block whitespace-nowrap z-10">Unit ${i} Status: ${i>22?'Critical':i>19?'Pending':'Operational'}</div>`;
                                gridContainer.appendChild(cell);
                            }
                        </script>

<script>
        // Simple intersection observer or animation for the gauge
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const circle = document.querySelector('.progress-ring__circle');
            if (circle) {
                const radius = circle.r.baseVal.value;
                const circumference = radius * 2 * Math.PI;
                const progress = 245 / 250;
                const offset = circumference - (progress * circumference);
                circle.style.strokeDasharray = `${circumference} ${circumference}`;
                circle.style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
            }
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

<script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Tab interaction simulation
            const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('button.font-label-caps');
            tabs.forEach(tab => {
                tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    tabs.forEach(t => {
                        t.classList.remove('tab-active', 'font-bold', 'text-primary');
                        t.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant');
                    });
                    tab.classList.add('tab-active', 'font-bold', 'text-primary');
                    tab.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant');
                });
            });

            // Ripple effect for the primary button
            const mainBtn = document.querySelector('button.bg-primary');
            mainBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                let ripple = document.createElement('span');
                ripple.classList.add('ripple');
                this.appendChild(ripple);
                setTimeout(() => ripple.remove(), 600);
            });
        });
    </script>
<style>
        .ripple {
            position: absolute;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            border-radius: 50%;
            transform: scale(0);
            animation: ripple 0.6s linear;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        @keyframes ripple {
            to {
                transform: scale(4);
                opacity: 0;
            }
        }
    </style>
</body></html>

PROJECT BRIEF 
# Project Requirements Document (PRD): HAR Mobile

## 1. Project Overview
**Project Name:** HAR Mobile (Sistem Digital Pemeliharaan Mesin)
**Organization:** PLN Nusa Daya
**Platform:** Android Mobile (Technicians/Operators) & Responsive Web (Super Admin)
**Language:** Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)

HAR Mobile is a high-fidelity digital maintenance reporting and management system. It bridges the gap between daily operational monitoring (Digital Logsheets) and maintenance execution (HAR Reports & Job Cards). The system ensures machine reliability through structured reporting, supervisor oversight, and unit-wide monitoring.

---

## 2. Problem Statement
Manual maintenance records are prone to data loss, lack of traceability, and delayed reporting. Operators often fail to link operational abnormalities (from logsheets) directly to maintenance actions, leading to potential machine failures.

---

## 3. Goals & Objectives
- **Digitalize Workflows:** Transition from paper-based logsheets and HAR reports to a mobile-first digital system.
- **Integrated Traceability:** Create a seamless link between Logsheet Abnormalities → HAR Reports → Supervisor Approval → Job Card Execution.
- **Operational Efficiency:** Enable real-time monitoring of machine health and maintenance progress for unit administrators.
- **Standardization:** Enforce consistent maintenance checklists and documentation requirements across all units.

---

## 4. User Roles & Permissions

| Role | Primary Responsibilities | Access Level |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Operator / Teknisi** | Fill logsheets, create HAR, execute Job Cards, upload documentation. | Field Execution |
| **Supervisor / PIC** | Review HAR, approve/reject reports, verify Job Cards, assign tasks. | Approval & Oversight |
| **Admin Unit** | Monitor unit-wide statistics, machine health, and task status. | Unit Monitoring |
| **Super Admin** | Manage users, master data, regional hierarchy, and system settings. | System Administration |

---

## 5. Core Workflows

### 5.1 Digital Logsheet to HAR
1. Operator enters machine operational data (Logsheet).
2. System validates values against "Normal" thresholds.
3. If **Abnormal**, system triggers an "Alert Abnormal" and prompts "Buat HAR."
4. Operator submits HAR for Supervisor review.

### 5.2 HAR Approval & Job Card
1. Supervisor reviews HAR (Findings, Actions, Photos).
2. Supervisor chooses: **Approve**, **Request Revision**, or **Reject**.
3. Upon **Approval**, a **Job Card** is automatically generated and assigned.
4. Technician executes the job, updates progress, and completes the Job Card.
5. Supervisor verifies the result for final completion.

---

## 6. Functional Requirements

### 6.1 Mobile Application
- **Auth:** Secure login with "Remember Me" and offline login support.
- **Unit Selection:** Cascading selection for Region > Area > Unit.
- **Logsheet Form:** Numeric inputs with unit labels (e.g., °C, Bar, KWh) and real-time validation.
- **HAR Creation:** Multi-step form (Information, Checklist, Findings, Actions, Documentation).
- **Photo Documentation:** Before, during, and after photo uploads with timestamps and captions.
- **Offline Mode:** Local data storage with manual/auto synchronization when connectivity is restored.

### 6.2 Management & Monitoring
- **Dashboards:** Role-specific summaries (e.g., active HAR counts, machine status charts).
- **Notifications:** Real-time alerts for approvals, revisions, and new Job Cards.
- **Event & Prevention:** Module to record significant maintenance events and root cause analysis.

---

## 7. Visual Identity & Design System
- **Theme:** Professional, Industrial, Enterprise.
- **Primary Color:** PLN Blue (#005daa).
- **Secondary Color:** PLN Yellow.
- **Framework:** Material Design 3 (M3).
- **Key UI Elements:** 
    - Large touch targets for outdoor use.
    - Status chips with consistent color coding (e.g., Green = Normal/Success, Orange = Warning, Red = Error/Abnormal).
    - Step-by-step progress indicators for long forms.

---

## 8. Technical Constraints
- **Platform:** Android-first mobile UI.
- **Connectivity:** Must support low-bandwidth and offline environments.
- **Data Integrity:** Mandatory fields for documentation and supervisor notes.


Prompt ini sengaja dibuat supaya Stitch tidak hanya menghasilkan halaman dashboard, tetapi memahami hubungan lengkap antara **Logsheet → kondisi abnormal → HAR → approval → Job Card → pekerjaan → verifikasi → monitoring**. Alur tersebut juga tetap memisahkan hak akses Operator/Teknisi, Supervisor/PIC, Admin Unit, dan Super Admin.


Brief tambahan ini penting karena membuat **Digital HAR bukan hanya aplikasi pelaporan**, tetapi juga menjadi **sistem predictive maintenance / maintenance scheduler**.

Inti flow tambahannya:

```text
Operator mengisi Digital Logsheet
        ↓
Jam kerja mesin bertambah otomatis
        ↓
Digital HAR membaca akumulasi jam kerja mesin
        ↓
Sistem membandingkan jam kerja dengan interval maintenance
        ↓
Mesin mendekati jadwal P2
        ↓
Digital HAR mengirim notifikasi
        ↓
“Besok mesin dijadwalkan P2”
        ↓
Supervisor / PIC menerima notifikasi
        ↓
Job Card P2 dibuat atau disiapkan
        ↓
Teknisi melakukan pekerjaan P2
        ↓
HAR diisi
        ↓
Supervisor melakukan verifikasi
        ↓
P2 selesai
        ↓
Sistem memperbarui jadwal maintenance berikutnya
```

Dari gambar tambahan, saya menangkap flow besarnya mengarah ke:

```text
Digital Logsheet
      ↓
Jam Kerja Mesin
      ↓
Monitoring Jam Operasi
      ↓
Mendekati Jadwal Maintenance
      ↓
Notifikasi P1 / P2 / P3
      ↓
Pembuatan Job Card
      ↓
Pekerjaan Maintenance
      ↓
Input HAR
      ↓
Review / Approval
      ↓
Update Riwayat dan Jadwal Berikutnya
```

Berikut **prompt tambahan yang bisa ditempelkan setelah prompt sebelumnya di Stitch**. Bagian ini akan menambahkan fitur otomatis berdasarkan jam kerja mesin.

```text
The next maintenance schedule must be automatically calculated.
```

Dengan tambahan ini, konsep HAR menjadi lebih kuat: **Logsheet menjadi sumber data jam kerja**, lalu **Digital HAR secara otomatis menghitung jadwal P1/P2/P3**, memberi peringatan sebelum jatuh tempo, dan menyiapkan pekerjaan pemeliharaan. Ini sesuai dengan brief bahwa ketika mesin mendekati **250 jam untuk P2**, aplikasi memberi sinyal bahwa **besok mesin dijadwalkan P2**.
Project Brief: HAR Mobile (Sistem Digital Pemeliharaan Mesin)

1. Project Overview

HAR Mobile is a high-fidelity enterprise mobile application designed for PLN Nusa Daya. It serves as a unified digital ecosystem for machine maintenance (Harkat & Pemeliharaan - HAR), integrating operational data from digital logsheets with proactive maintenance scheduling and reporting.

The application transitions the maintenance workflow from manual, reactive reporting to a data-driven, proactive asset management system.

2. Target Audience & Roles

The system supports a hierarchical organizational workflow with distinct permissions and views for each role:

3. Key Functional Pillars

A. Digital Logsheet & Real-time Monitoring





Operational Entry: Operators input machine parameters (Beban, Tekanan Oli, Temperatur, etc.).



Automatic Hour Accumulation: System calculates machine operating hours automatically from logsheet data.



Threshold Alerts: Immediate warnings when parameters exceed normal limits, triggering an optional "Buat HAR" flow.

B. Intelligent Maintenance Scheduler





Configurable Intervals: Supports flexible intervals (e.g., P1 every 100h, P2 every 250h, P3 every 500h).



Proactive Reminders: predictive scheduling based on current operating hours and average usage.



Status Levels:





Normal: Far from maintenance.



Monitoring: Approaching schedule.



Maintenance Soon: Within warning threshold (e.g., 5-10 hours remaining).



Maintenance Due: Interval reached.



Overdue: Interval exceeded.

C. HAR Reporting & Approval Workflow





Multi-step Creation: Information -> Checklist -> Findings -> Actions -> Documentation -> Review.



Rich Documentation: Before/During/After photo uploads with timestamps and captions.



Approval Loop: Seamless submission to Supervisors for review, revision requests, or final approval.

D. Job Card Execution





Work Orders: Approved HAR reports generate Job Cards.



Progress Tracking: Real-time status updates (Assigned -> Work Started -> Maintenance -> Verification).

4. Design & Technical Requirements

Visual Identity





Brand: PLN Nusa Daya (Professional, Industrial, Trustworthy).



Color Palette: PLN Blue (Primary), PLN Yellow (Secondary/Actions), Success Green, Warning Orange, Error Red.



System: Material Design 3.



Characteristics: Large touch targets (field-ready), high-readability typography (outdoor-ready), rounded cards, and clean spacing.

Technical Constraints





Device: Android Mobile (Primary), Responsive Web (Admin/Super Admin).



Offline Capability: Support for data entry in areas with poor connectivity with background synchronization.



Language: 100% Indonesian (Labels, Buttons, Statuses).

5. Primary User Flows





Logsheet to Alert: Logsheet Entry -> Abnormal Detected -> Alert Screen -> Create HAR.



Scheduled Maintenance: Operating Hours Update -> Schedule Reached -> Notification -> Job Card Creation -> Execution.



Approval Flow: Technician Submit -> Supervisor Review -> Revision Request -> Technician Edit -> Resubmit -> Approval.
